sv.title: Dadgostar vill syna Centerns bluff
sv.summary: Just nu skäller alla socialdemokrater på Nooshi Dadgostar. Om Vänsterpartiet vinner sitt slutspel är det nästan lika många som lär tacka henne – i alla fall i smyg.

en.title: Dadgostar wants to expose the Centre Party's bluff
en.summary: Right now everyone among the Social Democrats is attacking Nooshi Dadgostar. If the Left Party wins its play-off, almost as many will be thanking her – at least quietly.
